roadmap.title: First Nights on the Farm
roadmap.description: Set up the plot and grab the early one-off milestones: the first crop, first spell, first animal, first bouquet, and the start of the long-running gift, job, and coin counters.

roadmap.title: Town Rhythms, Festivals & Relationships
roadmap.description: Settle into the yearly calendar: festivals, hobbies, birthdays, friendships, and marriage, plus the relationship-gated side events.

roadmap.title: The Cursed Town Story
roadmap.description: Advance the main quest chain to lift the curse, open the map and the Museum, and unlock every shapeshifting form.

roadmap.title: The Seven Family Crests
roadmap.description: Finish the late-story family arcs and place each family's crest in the Crest Garden.

roadmap.title: Magic, Potions & Rituals
roadmap.description: Max out tools, mana, energy, spells, and potions, and light every Witch's Circle.

roadmap.title: Museum & Collections
roadmap.description: Finish the long-haul completion goals: the Museum, fish, Nokturna, Soul Blobs, Vampsters, house upgrades, and the million-coin target.

achievements.summary: Open the Museum by finishing the Curating the Museum quest.

steps.text: Visit @npc{Jada} at the museum to begin @mechanic{Curating the Museum}.
Clear the Museum Park and tell Jada it is cleared, then decorate the park and tell Jada you are finished.
Hand out 5 invites and attend the opening.

achievements.description: Lift the curse over the Misty Shores
achievements.summary: Break the Misty Shores curse by finishing the A Bridge Too Far quest.

guide.context: The 350-coin bar tab can be recovered from Mina, so the quest ends up costing nothing.

steps.text: Talk to @npc{Orlock}, then go to The Broken Lamp and settle his 350-coin debt with @npc{Samael}.
After the bar scene, find @npc{Mina} near Fiona's home in the Moonlit Pines and ask about the tab to receive the 350 coins.
Wait for Orlock to apologise, then ask Noel, Luna, and Sabrina for help.
Meet the group at the cursed bridge to lift the curse.

achievements.description: Place the Logan Crest in the Crest Garden
achievements.summary: Set the Logan family crest into the Crest Garden after the A Croak and a Crest quest.

steps.text: Meet @npc{Ludo} in the @loc{Howling Marshes}.
Collect Copper Ore inside the @loc{Cave of Echoes} and smelt it into a Copper Bar.
Carry a Copper Bar to the small pond in the Moonlit Pines, then return to the @loc{Crest Garden}.

achievements.description: Place the Webb Crest in the Crest Garden
achievements.summary: Set the Webb family crest into the Crest Garden after completing A Touch of Magic.

guide.context: The quest teaches the witch's utility spells before granting the crest.

steps.text: Cast a spell to grow a crop and a spell to make it rain.
Cast @mechanic{Hoisthaven} to move your house.
Visit the @loc{Crest Garden} to receive the Witch's Wand and the crest.

achievements.description: Place the Hosu Crest in the Crest Garden
achievements.summary: Set the Hosu family crest into the Crest Garden at the rehearsal dinner.

steps.text: Go to the @loc{Crest Garden} for the dinner rehearsal.

achievements.description: Place the Khazan Crest in the Crest Garden
achievements.summary: Set the Khazan family crest into the Crest Garden one day after The Moon in the Sky.

steps.text: Complete @mechanic{The Moon in the Sky} by meeting @npc{Selene} in Moonlit Pines.
Wait one in-game day, then set the Khazan family crest into the @loc{Crest Garden}.

achievements.description: Place the Henderson Crest in the Crest Garden
achievements.summary: Set the Henderson family crest into the Crest Garden after the Museum opening party.

steps.text: Complete @mechanic{Curating the Museum} and attend the opening party.
After waking, visit the @loc{Crest Garden} to find the Henderson Crest.

achievements.description: Place the Ambrosia Crest in the Crest Garden
achievements.summary: Set the Ambrosia family crest into the Crest Garden by finishing The Ambrosia Crisis.

guide.context: Orlock's materials come from crafting and refining, so prepare them before visiting.

steps.text: Visit the @loc{Ambrosia Mansion}.
Deliver Refined Stone x10, Gold Bar x6, and Glass x6 to @npc{Orlock}.
Go to the @loc{Crest Garden}.

achievements.description: Place the Dracula Crest in the Crest Garden
achievements.summary: Set the Dracula family crest into the Crest Garden after the Town Hall Drama quest.

guide.context: All seven family crests are placed at once, which also spawns an Arcane Flame in the Crest Garden.

steps.text: Complete @mechanic{Town Hall Drama} by visiting the town hall.

achievements.summary: Travel to the moon during the Moon Goddess's A Moonlit Bond heart event.

guide.context: The event belongs to the Moon Goddess and begins at the Khazan Temple.

steps.text: Raise friendship with the @npc{Moon Goddess} to 1 heart.
Go to the @loc{Khazan Temple} to trigger @mechanic{A Moonlit Bond} and travel to the moon.

achievements.summary: Unlock the Hellkitten form after attending the Ambrosia Mansion dinner party.

guide.context: The Dinner Party is the quest that introduces the forms wheel.

steps.text: Invite @npc{Elvira}, @npc{Samael}, @npc{Mina}, @npc{Evan}, and @npc{Ridge} to the dinner.
Join the dinner at the @loc{Ambrosia Mansion}; the Hellkitten form unlocks afterward.

achievements.summary: Unlock the Bat form by completing the Master of the Night quest.

guide.context: The quest becomes available after The Moon in the Sky, and entering Misty Shores starts it.

steps.text: Bring @npc{Orlock} a glass of Red Wine at the Ambrosia Mansion, then collect his special order at Coffee & Coffins.
Talk to @npc{Jarvis}, then find the 3 Chalice Pieces in @loc{Misty Shores}.
Talk to @npc{Mina} about the Chalice and repair it at a Furnace.
Return the Chalice to the Ambrosia Mansion.
Bring a Raspberry or Cranberry to the graveyard.

achievements.summary: Unlock the Mermaid form by completing The Mermaid's Wish quest.

guide.context: The ground shell powder is the key item that grants the Mermaid form.

steps.text: Ask @npc{Yabbis} in Moonlit Pines about growing legs.
Recover one special shell from the @loc{Cave of Echoes} and another from the @loc{Misty Shores}.
Grind both shells in an Alchemic Mortar.
Carry the shell powder to @loc{Luna Bay}.

achievements.description: Welcome a new family to town
achievements.summary: Welcome the Henderson family to town by completing the A New Beginning quest.

steps.text: Bring @npc{Ludo} a Fried Egg.
Deliver a housewarming present to the Hendersons the next night.

achievements.summary: Plant a crop on the farm for the first time.

steps.text: Speak with @npc{Orlock} outside the farmhouse and accept the 6 @item{Blood Grape Seeds} he offers.
Equip the @item{Shovel} and dig a patch of soil to till it.
Select the @item{Blood Grape Seeds} in your inventory, choose @mechanic{Plant}, then confirm the tilled soil to sow the crop.

achievements.summary: Cast your first spell after repairing the broken wand.

guide.context: Spellcasting stays locked until the wand is repaired, and Luna's quest is the only way to do it.

steps.text: Visit @loc{Luna's Farm} in Moonlit Pines and speak with @npc{Luna}.
Take the broken wand to @loc{Webb of Wonders} and have @npc{Sabrina} repair it.
Show the repaired wand to Luna at her farm.
Water the Moonfruit with @mechanic{Aquaflux I}, then return to Luna's Farm the next night.

achievements.summary: Discover Luna Bay by completing the A Curious Passage quest.

steps.text: Meet @npc{Ludo} in the @loc{Howling Marshes}.
Meet @npc{Tae}, then report back to Ludo to open Luna Bay.

achievements.summary: Help Ludo fix the broken bench through the job-board request.

guide.context: The request is tied to Ridge's birthday around Autumn 17-18 and may only appear in Year 2.

steps.text: Check the job board for the @mechanic{Fix Broken Bench} request and deliver Wood x5 for @npc{Ludo}.
Walk into town to trigger the cutscene where Ludo reveals the repaired bench.

achievements.summary: Marry a romanceable resident by reaching 8 hearts and proposing.

guide.context: Only romanceable residents can be dated; the relationship advances through hearts and dates.

steps.text: Reach 4 hearts with a romanceable resident and accept a date to become partners.
Reach 8 hearts, choose the proposal option, and complete the wedding.

achievements.summary: Adopt a farm creature from Luna's farm once the Barn is unlocked.

steps.text: Finish the @mechanic{Farm Animals for Sale} quest, which unlocks the @loc{Barn} blueprint at the Howling Hammer.
Build the Barn, then purchase an animal at Luna's farm in Moonlit Pines.

achievements.description: Make a flower arrangement, embroidery, or vase
achievements.summary: Create a flower arrangement, embroidery piece, or vase at Luna's Bloom Boutique.

steps.text: Visit @loc{Luna's Bloom Boutique}, which opens beside Webb of Wonders after The Magic of Crops.
Craft any flower bouquet, embroidery, or vase at the shop.

achievements.summary: Build the Greenhouse by reaching 80% Museum completion and paying Ridge 50,000 coins.

guide.context: The Greenhouse is locked behind Museum progress and appears at the Howling Hammer once 80% is reached.

steps.text: Raise Museum completion to 80%.
Purchase the Greenhouse at the @loc{Howling Hammer} from @npc{Ridge} for 50,000 coins.

achievements.summary: Reach Spring of Year 2 to complete your first year.

steps.text: Play through all four seasons until Spring of Year 2 arrives.

achievements.description: Talk to a creature in Hellkitten form
achievements.summary: Talk to a farm animal or Vampster while transformed into a Hellkitten.

steps.text: Open the forms wheel and transform into a @mechanic{Hellkitten}.
Talk to any farm animal or a Vampster.

achievements.description: Upgrade any tool to its Enchanted version
achievements.summary: Turn any tool into its Enchanted version at Webb of Wonders.

guide.context: The Enchanted tier only appears after a short wait, so the upgrade cannot be rushed.

steps.text: At the Howling Hammer, pay for a Gold upgrade on any tool.
Wait 6 in-game days.
On the sixth night, leave the house to trigger Noel's Enchanted Tools cutscene, then buy the Enchanted tool from Sabrina at Webb of Wonders.

achievements.displayName: One Collection to Rule Them All
achievements.summary: Complete the Museum by donating every crop, fish, critter, and relic.

guide.context: Museum progress is the combined total across all rooms, and the Farming Collection specifically wants 2-star crops.

steps.text: Open the Museum through @mechanic{Curating the Museum}.

Complete every room checklist: the Aquarium (21 entries), the Critter Room (95 critters), the Farming Room (55 crop and growable entries), and the Witch, Vampire, Werewolf, Mermaid, Seer, and Deity relic collections.
Keep donating until the Museum reads 100%.

achievements.summary: Obtain all 67 Nokturna cards.

guide.context: Cards come from the world and from residents, and only the first win against an opponent each day gives a new card.

steps.text: Dig dirt spots, dive in water, fish, and search bat nooks for stray cards.
Win once per night against each Nokturna-playing resident to earn their card drops.
Repeat until the collection holds all 67 cards.

achievements.summary: Reach 4 hearts with all 26 giftable residents of Moonlight Peaks.

guide.context: The Sun God caps at 1 heart and is not part of the requirement, and several residents only become giftable as the story advances.

steps.text: Unlock every giftable resident by finishing @mechanic{A New Beginning} (Jada, Persephone, Winston) and @mechanic{A Curious Passage} (Tae, Rei, Kim).
Advance the story until Llemi plus the Moon Goddess and Sun God can receive gifts, then complete @npc{Persephone}'s 4 Heart event to unlock Penelope (Skull Girl).
Gift and talk to each resident daily until all 26 giftable residents reach 4 hearts.

achievements.description: Discover all locations in Moonlight Peaks
achievements.summary: Discover every location in Moonlight Peaks, including the Moonlit Slopes.

guide.context: Some locations stay hidden until the Mermaid and Bat forms and the Twilight Catacombs are unlocked.

steps.text: Progress the main story to The Moon in the Sky to clear the mist from Moonlit Slopes.
Visit the remaining optional areas as well, including the Pink Grove, Luna Bay, the caves, and the Twilight Catacombs.

achievements.summary: Earn a lifetime total of 1,000,000 coins.

guide.context: The counter tracks total coins earned over the playthrough rather than the current balance.

steps.text: Process crops into wine, beer, honey, and cooked dishes to raise their sale value.
Sell steadily through Chester's shipping bin until lifetime earnings pass 1,000,000 coins.

achievements.summary: Collect all 100 Soul Blobs with the Net from Death.

guide.context: Caught Soul Blobs leave the pool permanently, and every region of the map holds some, including the Twilight Catacombs.

steps.text: Wait for Death's event after the Ambrosia storyline and accept the Net.
Sweep each region with the Net and catch the floating skulls.
Keep hunting until the Almanac shows all 100 Soul Blobs caught.
steps.note: Milestones at 10, 50, and 100 Soul Blobs award Antique Clocks that change the night length.

achievements.description: Return all Vampsters to their den
achievements.summary: Bring every one of the 100 lost Vampsters back to the den inside the Cave of Echoes.

guide.context: Four Vampsters only appear during the seasonal festivals and must be returned the same day, and the last ones sit in the Twilight Catacombs.

steps.text: Meet @npc{Alina} in the @loc{Cave of Echoes} after A Bridge Too Far to start the collection.
Find the lost Vampsters across every region and carry them back to the den.
Return during the Loveage, Evernight, and Winterwake festivals to catch the seasonal Vampsters.
Unlock the Twilight Catacombs and return the remaining Vampsters.

achievements.summary: Cook 25 different recipes after learning their blueprints.

guide.context: Each distinct dish counts once, so repeats do not advance the total.

steps.text: Collect recipe blueprints by digging dirt spots in @mechanic{Hellkitten} form, diving in @mechanic{Mermaid} form, and searching windowsills in @mechanic{Bat} form.
Learn the blueprints, then cook each recipe once until 25 different dishes are registered.

achievements.description: Complete 25 jobs from the job board
achievements.summary: Complete 25 jobs posted on Albertus' job board in town.

guide.context: The board refreshes on its own cycle, so check it regularly rather than waiting to batch jobs.

steps.text: Use @npc{Albertus}' job board in town and accept the posted jobs.
Finish and hand in jobs until 25 have been completed.

achievements.summary: Reach maximum Mana by collecting all five Arcane Flames.

guide.context: Mana starts at 3 and reaches its maximum of 8 once all five Arcane Flames are held.

collectibles.name: Arcane Flame 1
collectibles.method: Buy from Sabrina for 10,000 coins once the wand is repaired.

collectibles.name: Arcane Flame 2
collectibles.method: Buy from Sabrina for 399 Evernight Coins during Autumn 26-28.

collectibles.name: Arcane Flame 3
collectibles.method: Receive it from Jada at 50% Museum completion.

collectibles.name: Arcane Flame 4
collectibles.method: Receive it from Llemi after reaching 4 hearts with every resident except the Sun God.

collectibles.name: Arcane Flame 5
collectibles.method: Collect it after all seven family crests are placed.

achievements.summary: Reach maximum Energy by collecting all five Scarlet Teardrops.

guide.context: The Mermaid and Bat forms gate three of the teardrops, the fourth needs the A Missing Moon quest, and the last is tied to the Vampster collection.

collectibles.name: Scarlet Teardrop 1
collectibles.location: Farm's southwest beach, south of Viktor's Crypt
collectibles.method: Transform into a Mermaid and swim to the offshore beach.

collectibles.name: Scarlet Teardrop 2
collectibles.method: Swim from Luna Bay into the grove, then cross the river to the trees.

collectibles.name: Scarlet Teardrop 3
collectibles.method: Use Bat form to fly to the floating island in the middle of the chasm.

collectibles.name: Scarlet Teardrop 4
collectibles.location: Lost Moon Alcove, Cave of Echoes
collectibles.method: Finish A Missing Moon, leave the cave, then re-enter the alcove.

collectibles.name: Scarlet Teardrop 5
collectibles.method: Return all 100 Vampsters; the teardrop is given in the cutscene.

achievements.summary: Attend your first Yoga session after completing the Cosmic Preparations quest.

steps.text: Gather Rose Quartz x6 for @npc{Persephone} to help set up the yoga space.
Go to the yoga space's grand opening and join your first session.

achievements.summary: Return all the plastic chairs to Ludo, Orlock, and Evan.

guide.context: The quest unlocks after the Draculas' tea party in A Family Reunion.

steps.text: Complete @mechanic{A Family Reunion} to unlock the plastic-chairs quest.
Return the plastic chairs to @npc{Ludo}, one lawn chair to @npc{Orlock}, and one lawn chair to @npc{Evan}.

achievements.description: Fall in love with a tree
achievements.summary: Fall in love with a tree by triggering Luna's Hug a Tree heart event.

guide.context: Heart events appear on the map as an exclamation point over the area where they trigger.

steps.text: Raise friendship with @npc{Luna} until her 1 Heart event is available.
Enter the @loc{Moonlit Pines} to trigger the @mechanic{Hug a Tree} event.

achievements.summary: Meet Pumpkin Head by entering town when Autumn begins.

guide.context: Pumpkin Head is a seasonal deity who only appears during Autumn.

steps.text: Enter Moonlight Peaks town on Autumn 1 to trigger the Pumpkin Head cutscene.

achievements.summary: Complete Elvira's five-clue treasure hunt.

guide.context: The hunt is Elvira's 4 Heart event.

steps.text: Raise friendship with @npc{Elvira} to 4 hearts to start the treasure hunt.
Collect the five clues at The Broken Lamp, the Ambrosia Graveyard, Webb of Wonders, the Cave of Echoes, and the Khazan Temple.

achievements.summary: Build a treehouse with Ridge during his 4 Heart event in the Misty Shores.

steps.text: Reach 4 hearts with @npc{Ridge}.
Enter the @loc{Misty Shores} to trigger his event and help build the treehouse.

achievements.summary: Watch the Draculambs march through town during winter.

steps.text: During winter, enter Moonlight Peaks town until the Draculamb march cutscene plays.
steps.note: The march is a town event with no fixed date, so entering town on several winter nights may be needed.

achievements.summary: Win the Mastersoup cooking contest on the 5th Night of Autumn.

guide.context: Mina hosts the contest once a year, and a wrong ingredient is flagged immediately so you can retry the dish.

steps.text: Enter town on the @mechanic{5th Night of Autumn} to start the Mastersoup event against Fiona, Alina, and Death.
In the soup round, select the correct ingredients for the dish shown from memory.
steps.note: Soup recipes: Gazpacho Soup = Blood Tomato + Onion; Mushroom Soup = Yellow Glowglammer + Common Mushroom; Angry Soup = Lava Pepper + Angry Mandrake + Suffrain Powder; Carrot Soup = Carrot + Henbane Powder.

steps.text: Repeat for the main-course round.
steps.note: Main-course recipes: Farmer's Stew = Blood Tomato + Eggplant; Orbis Nigiri = Orbis + Rice; Mushroom Stew = Glowglammer + Volacio + Yellow Glowglammer; Blueberry Pancakes = Piggoat Milk + Blueberry + Flour + Egg; Breakfast Burger = Fried Egg + Bread + Blood Tomato; Margherita Pizza = Blood Tomato + Flour + Cheese; Veggie Burrito = Tortilla + Blood Tomato + Rice.

steps.text: Win the dessert round to claim the Mastersoup Trophy.
steps.note: Dessert recipes: Blood Orange Cupcake = Blood Orange + Flour + Honey; Ollebrod = Bread + Beer; Crimson Pudding = Strawberry + Raspberry + Cowcula Milk; Red Velvet Cupcake = Flour + Cocoa Powder; Raspberry Cupcake = Flour + Raspberry; Chocolate Cupcake = Chocolate + Flour.

achievements.description: Open the door to the Catacombs
achievements.summary: Open the door to the Twilight Catacombs after reaching 25% Museum completion.

guide.context: The key is awarded at 25% Museum completion, which overlaps with the earlier collection goals.

steps.text: Reach 25% Museum completion to receive the Dracula Insignia Key from @npc{Jada}.
Show @npc{Viktor} the key at his crypt.
Explore the Catacombs to unlock the @loc{Twilight Catacombs}.

achievements.summary: Befriend Death by giving gifts he loves until the friend status is reached.

guide.context: Death uses the same heart system as other residents.

steps.text: Give @npc{Death} gifts he loves, such as Black Azalea, Bloody Mana Mary, Eggnog, Gluhwein, or trash items like the Old Shoe.
Continue until the friend status appears.

achievements.summary: Catch the rare fish named Missing.

guide.context: Missing can turn up in several waters and is not tied to a season.

steps.text: Unlock fishing through @mechanic{Outfish the Fisherman}.
Upgrade to the Premium and then the Enchanted Fishing Rod.
Keep fishing at the different waters until a Missing bites.

achievements.description: Give 25 characters a loved gift on the same night
achievements.summary: Give a loved gift to 25 different residents in a single night.

guide.context: All 26 giftable residents must be unlocked first, and each needs a loved item offered on the same night.

steps.text: Finish the story arcs that add the mermaids, the Hendersons, the Hosus, Llemi, the Moon Goddess, the Sun God, and Pumpkin Head.
Stock one loved item per resident; many accept Diamond, and each resident has a favourite flower colour.
From nightfall, gift 25 different residents their loved item before the night ends.
steps.note: Fiona's and Pumpkin Head's loved-item reactions are glitched, so do not rely on them for this run.

achievements.summary: Give Charcoal to Pakkeleg at the Winterwake Festival gift exchange.

guide.context: The Charcoal must be in your inventory when Pakkeleg asks for the entry gift.

steps.text: Make @item{Charcoal} before or during the event.
At the @mechanic{Pakkeleg Gift Exchange}, choose @item{Charcoal} when Pakkeleg requests a gift for entry.

achievements.description: Sell items worth over 9,000 coins in one night
achievements.summary: Sell items worth more than 9,000 coins through Chester's shipping bin in a single night.

guide.context: The counter measures the combined value sold that night, and payment arrives the next morning.

steps.text: Drop high-value goods such as wine, beer, or cooked dishes into @npc{Chester}'s shipping bin.
Check the running total with Chester and keep adding goods until it passes 9,000 coins before the night ends.

achievements.description: Have all potion effects active at once
achievements.summary: Keep every potion effect active at the same time.

guide.context: Potion making must be unlocked before any potion can be brewed.

steps.text: Finish @mechanic{Mend it with Magic}: speak with the witches about the Broken Cauldron, then supply Fiona with mana essence and wait for the Cauldron.
Buy every potion recipe at Webb of Wonders and brew them at a Cauldron.
Drink the potions together so their effects overlap.

achievements.summary: Max out every spell, including Wanderer's Hex from Sabrina.

guide.context: Tiered spells must each be upgraded to level III, and Wanderer's Hex is the final spell.

steps.text: Buy every spell sold at Webb of Wonders.
Upgrade the tiered spells — Aquaflux, Ethereal Hands, Ethereal Shovels, Ethereal Axes, Ethereal Pickaxes, Maturio, Metamorphosia, and Arborascend — to level III.
Reach 4 hearts with @npc{Sabrina} to receive Wanderer's Hex by letter.

achievements.summary: Fully upgrade your house with all four expansions from Ridge.

guide.context: Upgrades become available after Fix the Roof, and each one finishes after a night's sleep.

steps.text: At the Howling Hammer, speak with @npc{Ridge} and buy upgrade 1: 8,000 coins, Wood x100, Stone x25.
Buy upgrade 2: 25,000 coins, Wood x200, Refined Stone x50.
Buy upgrade 3: 50,000 coins, Planks x150, Refined Stone x50.
Buy upgrade 4: 100,000 coins, Hardwood Planks x150, Refined Stone x100.
steps.note: Hardwood Planks are crafted from Weeping Willow wood or the large logs on the farm.

achievements.summary: Catch all 22 fish species in Moonlight Peaks.

guide.context: Large fish need the Premium Fishing Rod, and some species only appear at a set time, season, or weather.

collectibles.name: Splotch
collectibles.method: Common catch with the base Fishing Rod.

collectibles.name: Whisper
collectibles.method: Common catch with the base Fishing Rod.

collectibles.name: Orbis
collectibles.method: Uncommon catch with the base Fishing Rod.

collectibles.name: Glibby
collectibles.method: Uncommon catch with the base Fishing Rod.

collectibles.name: Violet
collectibles.method: Uncommon catch with the base Fishing Rod.

collectibles.name: Goldy
collectibles.method: Uncommon, only in spring and summer.

collectibles.name: Gnasher
collectibles.method: Large fish, needs the Premium Fishing Rod.

collectibles.name: Brickle
collectibles.method: Uncommon catch with the base Fishing Rod.

collectibles.name: Glammer
collectibles.method: Uncommon catch with the base Fishing Rod.

collectibles.name: Snuffy
collectibles.method: Uncommon catch with the base Fishing Rod.

collectibles.name: Leftsee
collectibles.method: Uncommon catch in the cave water.

collectibles.name: Daybreaker
collectibles.method: Large fish; bites in the morning, needs the Premium Fishing Rod.

collectibles.name: Twilight
collectibles.method: Uncommon, appears between 6 and 8 PM.

collectibles.name: Mouthout
collectibles.method: Uncommon, only bites while it is raining.

collectibles.name: Moonflutter
collectibles.method: Large fish, only on a full moon; needs the Premium Fishing Rod.

collectibles.name: Amour
collectibles.method: Rare catch with the base Fishing Rod.

collectibles.name: Furybud
collectibles.method: Rare large fish, needs the Premium Fishing Rod.

collectibles.name: Gloy Gloy
collectibles.method: Rare large fish, needs the Premium Fishing Rod.

collectibles.name: Skullfin
collectibles.method: Rare catch in the cave water.

collectibles.name: Fortipod
collectibles.method: Rare, only in winter.

collectibles.name: Goliath
collectibles.method: Super-rare very large fish that needs the Premium Fishing Rod.

collectibles.name: Missing
collectibles.location: Several waters, including the Cave of Echoes
collectibles.method: Rare special catch with no season or time restriction.

achievements.summary: Activate all five Witch's Circles with the Wanderer's Hex spell.

guide.context: Wanderer's Hex is learned from Sabrina at 4 hearts, and each circle only needs activating once.

steps.text: Reach 4 hearts with @npc{Sabrina} and learn @mechanic{Wanderer's Hex}.
Stand inside each of the five @loc{Witch's Circles} and cast the spell to turn them into fast-travel points.

achievements.description: Talk to a werewolf during a full moon
achievements.summary: Talk to a werewolf on the night of a full moon.

guide.context: Full moons fall on the 15th of each month.

steps.text: Wait for the full moon on the 15th.
Talk to any Logan werewolf — Brook, Ludo, Ridge, or Saga.

achievements.description: Win a round of Nokturna by scoring 30+ points
achievements.summary: Win a Nokturna round with a score of 30 points or more.

guide.context: A match is best of three rounds, and each round is scored from the cards played.

steps.text: Build a strong 20-card deck.
Challenge a low-level opponent such as Dragan or Death and win a round with 30 or more points.

achievements.description: Pet your Hellkitten for 5 consecutive minutes
achievements.summary: Pet your Hellkitten for five consecutive minutes without stopping.

steps.text: Transform into a Hellkitten and use the pet action.
Stay in the petting animation for five full minutes without choosing to stop.
steps.note: The timer only counts while petting continues, so do not cancel early.

achievements.summary: Give the town's residents 299 gifts.

guide.context: The recipient's taste is irrelevant, so any spare item advances the counter.

steps.text: Speak with any resident, choose the @mechanic{Gift} option, and hand over any inventory item.
Repeat until 299 gifts have been given.
